summary: Completed backend+frontend validation for driver mobile redesign and profile/auth integrations. Driver login (email/phone), mobile tabs (Acasă/Livrare/Calendar/Profil), profile persistence/validation, and admin regression route/content all passed. One critical auth preflight CORS defect remains.

critical.issue: Credentialed preflight still returns `access-control-allow-origin: *` instead of explicit allowed origin.

action_items: Fix effective runtime CORS preflight handling for credentialed auth requests so ACAO returns explicit frontend origin.
Retest OPTIONS /api/auth/login from public ingress after CORS fix.
Refactor `/api/seed` strategy to idempotent update behavior for admin credentials instead of full delete/recreate if this playbook rule is required for production seeding.
critical_code_review_comments: `/app/backend/routers/seed.py` still hard-deletes users/drivers/restaurants/orders on each seed call (`delete_many({})`), which conflicts with playbook expectation that seed_admin updates existing admin credentials idempotently.
Auth middleware/runtime mismatch persists: API declares explicit origins, but effective external preflight response is wildcard (`*`) while credentials are enabled.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Driver app mobile shell and requested tabs/fields are working on public URL. Frontend explicitly shows SMS future-state text (no fake SMS success). Existing Admin Settings remains MOCKED/demo backlog (known context). Remaining blocker is credentialed auth preflight wildcard CORS response.
rca of the issue: Repro: send OPTIONS to `/api/auth/login` with `Origin=https://delivery-dispatch-17.preview.emergentagent.com` and `Access-Control-Request-Method=POST`. Response returns `access-control-allow-origin: *` plus credentials, which is invalid for browser credentialed requests. Likely ingress/edge preflight handling bypasses or overrides backend explicit-origin CORS policy.
